alternatives.name: kwent/syno
alternatives.description: Node.js wrapper and CLI for Synology DSM REST API 6.x/7.x. Covers FileStation, DownloadStation, AudioStation, VideoStation, SurveillanceStation, Synology Photos.

alternatives.name: N4S4/synology-api
alternatives.description: Python library (not a CLI) covering 300+ Synology API methods.
coverage_gaps: Library, not a CLI - no direct command-line invocation
No structured output (JSON/table) for shell consumption

alternatives.name: reddec/syno-cli
alternatives.description: Go CLI for Synology with certificate management and Download Station.
coverage_gaps: Only covers certificates and Download Station
No Hyper Backup, Storage, Task Scheduler, File Station

alternatives.name: synology-community/go-synology
alternatives.description: OpenAPI definition + Go client for DSM. Covers VM/Virtualization only.
coverage_gaps: No CLI - only a Go library
No Hyper Backup, Storage, Task Scheduler, Containers, File Station

alternatives.name: hacf-fr/synologydsm-api
alternatives.description: Python wrapper used by Home Assistant integration. Covers system info, storage, surveillance.
coverage_gaps: Home Assistant integration focus, not a general CLI

what_alternatives_miss: No Go binary CLI with zero runtime dependency covers the full priority surface
No existing tool provides: Hyper Backup status/trigger + Storage health + Task Scheduler + Container Manager logs in a single binary
None offer --json output suitable for agent/automation consumption
None handle session management with config file persistence
No CLI with doctor/health-check command for the full API surface
what_alternatives_do_well: N4S4/synology-api has the most comprehensive API coverage (300+ methods)
kwent/syno has good documentation and active community
N4S4's source code is the best reference for exact API names, methods, and version numbers

novelty_rationale: Score 8/10: No existing Go binary CLI covers the priority surface (Hyper Backup + Storage + Task Scheduler + Containers + File Station). The hand-written bash CLI at ~/go/bin/synology-nas-pp-cli covers only SSH-dispatched commands with no REST API access. The generated CLI fills a real gap in the ecosystem with agent-friendly output, zero runtime dependency, and session management.

gaps: Cannot create Task Scheduler tasks (SSH dispatch doesn't support it)
No Hyper Backup REST API access
No rich container management (only basic docker ps via SSH)
Commands limited to what was whitelisted in nas-dispatch.sh
existing_bash_cli.note: Do NOT delete or modify - remains in place until new CLI is vetted
